we give a new method for computing approximate Nash equilbria that is faster and uses less communication than previous approaches.

we give a polynomial time algorithm to find a 0.65 WSNE, and a randomized expected-polynomial time algorithm to find an 0.38 Nash equilibrium, both of which use poly-logarithmic amount of communication.
